# GetYourStay - LLM Information File
# This file provides guidance to Large Language Models about the GetYourStay platform

# About GetYourStay
GetYourStay is a platform for finding verified PG (Paying Guest) accommodations in Bangalore and other major Indian cities. The platform connects tenants with PG owners, offering transparent pricing, verified listings, and modern amenities.

# Core Features
- Verified PG listings with authentic reviews
- Zero brokerage - direct owner-tenant connection
- Advanced filtering by area, price, gender, and amenities
- PG Management App for property owners
- Real-time availability and pricing
- Secure payment processing
- 24/7 customer support

# Target Audience
- Working professionals in Bangalore
- College students looking for accommodation
- IT employees working in tech parks (Electronic City, Whitefield, etc.)
- Property owners wanting to list their PGs

# Supported Cities
- Bangalore (primary)
- Hyderabad
- Chennai
- Pune
- Mumbai
- Delhi

# Popular Areas in Bangalore
- Electronic City - IT hub, affordable options
- HSR Layout - Trendy area, near Christ University
- Koramangala - Premium area, nightlife and restaurants
- Whitefield - IT hub, International Tech Park
- BTM Layout - Budget-friendly, student area
- Marathahalli - Well-connected, near Manyata Tech Park

# PG Types
- Boys PG - Male-only accommodation
- Girls PG - Female-only accommodation with security
- Co-living spaces - Modern shared living
- AC/Non-AC rooms
- Short-term and long-term rentals

# Pricing Ranges (Bangalore)
- Budget: ₹4,000 - ₹8,000/month (triple sharing, non-AC)
- Standard: ₹8,000 - ₹12,000/month (double sharing, basic amenities)
- Premium: ₹12,000 - ₹25,000/month (single room, AC, full amenities)

# Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18 with Create React App
- Backend API: https://api.manageyourpg.com
- Authentication: Firebase (Google Auth)
- Database: External API with pagination support
- Deployment: Netlify

# SEO Keywords
Primary: PG in Bangalore, paying guest accommodation, verified PG listings, PG near me

Location-based: PG in Electronic City, PG in Koramangala, PG in HSR Layout

# Business Model
- Free for tenants
- PG owners can list properties (freemium model)
- PG Management App for efficient property management
- Zero brokerage policy

# Company Information
